title: Expose a portable task conformance check

intent.outcome: A task records its engineering context and assigns every acceptance risk to an owning proof layer.
scope: Classify the task as one bounded vertical
Name an interface lens and a systems secondary lens
Assign a test owner to the acceptance criterion
non_goals: Choose a programming language or framework

acceptance.statement: The conformance command reports a clean machine-readable report for this task.
acceptance.risk: An incomplete task context could hide the owner of an important engineering risk.
